description: This file contains controller functions for managing message-related operations in a Node.js application, including fetching, toggling read status, and removing messages.

methods.name: getMyMessages
methods.description: Fetches all messages for the authenticated user.

methods.name: getSingle
methods.description: Retrieves a single message by ID for the authenticated user.

methods.name: toggleRead
methods.description: Toggles the read status of a specific message.
